weekly.love: Connection deepens when you show up as your authentic self. If you've been holding back vulnerability, this week invites you to share what's real. Singles might feel unexpected sparks; coupled folks are reminded why they fell in love.
weekly.career: Your ideas are landing differently right now—people are actually listening. This is the moment to pitch that project or speak up in meetings. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed, even if it doesn't fit the mold.
